# Additional Information on WhatsApp Onboarding - WXCC

Source: https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/wxcc-additional-information-on-whatsapp-onboarding
Documentation version: 6.20.0
Retrieved: 2026-09-08T23:29:13+00:00

If your business desires to have a WhatsApp Official Business Account, it must be considered a notable business that has a substantial presence in news articles from publications with sizable audiences. WhatsApp Official Business Accounts are issued for phone numbers. With the same phone number, you can use the current or a new business name to apply for the WhatsApp Official Business Account.

Once you have initiated business verification, please reach out to your support contact it you intend to become a WhatsApp Official Business Account.
